findings.issue: Pokémon cards (id/name/sprite shape) are constructed inline in three different functions, so a card rule change such as the sprite-source fix must be applied three times with different data availability at each site.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single card builder (e.g. makeCard(species, sprite, extra)) and route all three sites through it.

findings.issue: The 'species → default Pokémon' rule (varieties.find(v => v.is_default)) is duplicated in getPokemonPage and getTeamPage.
findings.suggestion: Extract a getDefaultPokemon(species) helper next to the other shared index helpers.

findings.issue: Card.hidden is an ability-page-only concern baked into the shared card type and rendered by the generic PokemonCard ('Hidden ability', PokemonCard.svelte:20-22), coupling the shared abstraction to one feature.
findings.suggestion: Keep Card generic; let the ability page pass a footer snippet or extra-content prop to PokemonCard/CardList.

findings.issue: The cookie-backed team sync pattern (local $state copy, $effect overwrite on data change, saveTeam on mutation) is written independently in both team-touching pages (also team/+page.svelte:10-37).
findings.suggestion: Share a single reactive team store (a class with $state fields) so team semantics change in one module.

findings.issue: Column knowledge is duplicated: ALL_COLUMNS drives the sortable thead while tbody cells and the level-up condition (line 76-78) are hand-coded, so adding a column needs two coordinated edits.
findings.suggestion: Render tbody cells from the same column descriptors (or a cell snippet per column) so the column list is the single source.

findings.issue: The generic server data layer imports the team feature's client module just for TEAM_SIZE, making pokedex.ts aware of one route's feature.
findings.suggestion: Pass the concurrency limit as an argument or move TEAM_SIZE to a neutral constants module.

findings.issue: Uses a custom '#lib/*' package-import alias instead of SvelteKit's conventional '$lib'; consistent and functional (the path-based server-directory guard in SvelteKit 3 still protects lib/server), but diverges from what every SvelteKit contributor and tool expects.
findings.suggestion: Prefer '$lib' unless there's a documented reason for the deviation.

findings.issue: The team grid duplicates CardList's auto-fill grid CSS (minmax(--card-min-width)) to add remove buttons, so card-list layout changes must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Extend CardList with an optional per-item snippet (or a `let:item` render prop) and reuse it on the team page.

summary: This is a well-layered SvelteKit 3 codebase: thin loads, one server data module, one cached HTTP client, and small typed components, with config and runes usage current and idiomatic. The recurring editability cost is duplicated card/sprite/default-variety construction in pokedex.ts, which turns a single data-shape fix into a three-site change, plus a small feature leak (Card.hidden) into the shared card component. Everything else — removal, new Moves-like sections, data-source changes — lands close to where you'd expect, with one obvious file for the API seam.
